properties.Mechanism (MOA): Non-selective adrenergic agonist → α1 vasoconstriction (↑BP), β1 cardiac stimulation (↑HR/contractility), β2 bronchodilation (↓airway resistance).
properties.Contraindications: No absolute contraindication in anaphylaxis; caution in arrhythmias/ischemic heart disease when not life-saving.
properties.Indications: Anaphylaxis (first-line, high-yield); cardiac arrest; severe asthma exacerbation (context-dependent).
properties.Adverse effects: Arrhythmias, hypertension, tremor/anxiety; ischemia with excessive vasoconstriction.
